task.title: To install X-Author for Contracts add-in

step.cmd: If you are installing the X-Author for Contracts Advanced add-in on Windows operating system, sign in to Microsoft Word.
Select the Insert tab and click My Add-ins.
Use the search box to search for the X-Author for Contracts Advanced add-in. For example, you can use Conga or X-Author Contracts keywords to search for the add-in.
Click Add next to the X-Author for Contracts Advanced add-in.
Review the license terms and privacy policy and click Continue.

postreq.p: In the Home tab of Microsoft Word, you can see the X-Author Contracts Advanced ribbon.

note.p: In case you are a European customer, in the App store, search and find X-Author Contracts Advanced (EU) add-in and install the same.
